story: Eleven Mile State Park is located in Park County, Colorado, USA, and was established in 1970. The 7,662-acre park surrounds the Eleven Mile Canyon Reservoir and features trails for hikers and bicyclists. Animals such as coyotes and pronghorn can be seen in the park.
matters: The park and reservoir are located within the South Park National Heritage Area and impound the South Platte River. The reservoir is famous for its thriving Kokanee salmon population.
name: Eleven Mile State Park
